A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work and complete 67-page documents, including Appendices A–D. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish localized edits without missing material that limits comparison.

before.justification: Section 4, Table 1, and the appendices report original prediction and OOD-detection experiments on PDEs, humidity forecasting, image classification, and brain segmentation.

after.justification: Section 4, Table 1, and the appendices retain original experimental outcomes, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, and prediction-error analyses.

M1.justification: Joint denoiser training, likelihood estimation, OOD thresholding, and classification/segmentation adaptations remain unchanged. The score-definition correction does not revise Algorithm 1 or the described training and inference procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same toy regressions, PDE tasks, MERRA-2 forecasting regions, CIFAR-10/MNIST/SVHN tests, and BraTS2020 segmentation scenarios. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including the diffusion certificates and OODC in Table 1, MC-Dropout and Rate-In in Table 4, and persistence forecasting in Figure 24. The replaced reference is not a newly evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Data splits, preprocessing, model configurations, training budgets, evaluation metrics, and decision thresholds remain identical, including the settings in Appendices A.4 and B and Table 7.

E4.justification: The existing training-checkpoint, architecture, decision-boundary, computational-cost, input-only likelihood, label-perturbation, and segmentation-noise analyses are retained unchanged. No ablation, robustness test, or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: The ten-model repetitions in Appendix A.2.1 and percentile-based uncertainty bands and sensitivity analysis in Appendix B.4 are identical. No run-count, seed, or uncertainty-reporting procedure changes.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted data, and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains NS-MIX JLBC accuracy of 0.947 and AUROC of 0.992 in both versions.

T1.justification: Section 3 changes the score definition from s(z;t) ≈ ∇_x log p_t to s(z;t) = ∇_z log p_t, specifying the exact score with respect to the joint variable. This is a limited definition correction; Appendix A.1's assumptions and derivation remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The task-aware joint-likelihood certificate, zero-shot OOD detection, optional a posteriori error estimation, and cross-domain applicability claims are retained. Changing 'ground truth predictions' to 'ground truth samples' in Section 1.1 clarifies the existing claim.

C2.justification: The heuristic qualification in Section 3, model-selection limitation in Appendix B.1.4, and explanations concerning humidity ill-posedness and non-semantic pixel failure modes remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Solver and divergence-estimation details, hardware and timing information, architectures, hyperparameters, and training instructions remain unchanged in the appendices. The public-code access statement and link are also retained.

R1.justification: Reference 42 replaces Tang and Zhao's 2024 diffusion tutorial with Song et al.'s 2020 'Score-based generative modeling through stochastic differential equations,' redirecting the probability-flow and likelihood-estimation citations. The related-work discussion and novelty positioning otherwise remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Local edits replace 'ground truth predictions' with 'ground truth samples,' restore a missing closing parenthesis in Equation 3.2, and update the version/date stamp. Section ordering and narrative structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3's caption changes 'error–certificate histograms' to 'error–certificate plots,' accurately describing the retained display. Figure artwork and table structures are unchanged; caption and bibliography edits cause only local text reflow.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves precision by correcting the score definition, repairing Equation 3.2 to match the existing Appendix A.1 formula, and correcting Figure 3's description. These resolve local ambiguities, while the methodology, empirical support, and documented limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
